questions.title: HashMap iteration order
questions.question: Which statement about `java.util.HashMap` iteration order is correct?
questions.explanation: `HashMap` makes no ordering guarantees. Use `LinkedHashMap` for insertion order or `TreeMap` for sorted keys.
hints: Which Map implementation exists specifically to keep insertion order?

questions.title: Integer cache comparison
questions.explanation: Autoboxing uses `Integer.valueOf`, which caches -128..127, so `a` and `b` are the same object while `c` and `d` are two different objects.
hints: Autoboxing calls Integer.valueOf - what does it cache?
